page_title: STR 3-1 REN | Strasbourg v Rennes 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+9' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+7' A lofted pass into the box is met by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg), who rifles a shot just wide of the right post.
90+6' Strasbourg hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
90+4' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Strasbourg players look gutted.
90+4' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Strasbourg players aren’t happy.
90+4' Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) fires the ball inside the back of the net!
90+2' The shot by Ludovic Blas (Rennes) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Karl-Johan Johnsson.
90' Jordan James (Rennes) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
89' Leo Ostigard (Rennes) attempts to discuss the decision with Eric Wattellier, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
87' 3 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. Christopher Wooh (Rennes) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him, it's into his own goal!
85' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) tackles a bit over-zealously and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
83' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
81' Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Eric Wattellier no option but to blow his whistle.
80' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) replacing Habib Diarra.
80' Substitution. Caleb Wiley makes way for Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg).
78' Rennes fail to score from a corner as Karl-Johan Johnsson (Strasbourg) leaps to collect the ball.

78' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Karl-Johan Johnsson pulls off a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rennes.
77' Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
76' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Rennes keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
72' Substitution. Henrik Meister (Rennes) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Amine Gouiri walks off.
72' Julien Stephan prepares a substitution. Albert Gronbaek is replaced by Jordan James (Rennes).
72' Karl-Johan Johnsson (Strasbourg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
70' Karl-Johan Johnsson (Strasbourg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) will replace Ismael Doukoure.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.

67' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Corner kick. Rennes will have an opportunity.
66' Substitution. Emanuel Emegha is replaced by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg).
66' Liam Rosenior decides to make a substitution. Diego Moreira will be replaced by Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg).

62' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Steve Mandanda pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
59' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Eric Wattellier to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Rennes players can finally celebrate.
59' The Rennes players halt their celebrations as referee Eric Wattellier makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
58' It will be a substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is ready to enter the pitch as Alidu Seidu walks off.
58' Julien Stephan has decided to substitute Lorenz Assignon and he is replaced by Hans Hateboer (Rennes).
57' 2 - 1 Goal! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
56' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
55' Eric Wattellier interrupts the game. One of the players from Strasbourg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
52' A player from Rennes takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
48' 2 - 0 Goal! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
47' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
47' Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+1' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

44' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Karl-Johan Johnsson makes a brilliant save! The ball goes out of play and Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
40' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
37' Rennes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
37' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and it's Christopher Wooh (Rennes) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
36' A dangerous looking corner kick from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is cleared to safety by the defence.
34' Foul! Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
33' Rennes are seeing far more of the ball now.
30' Leo Ostigard (Rennes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for an infringement.
28' OFF THE BAR! Amine Gouiri (Rennes) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball crashes against the crossbar.
26' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) commits a rough foul. Eric Wattellier stops the game and makes a call.
25' One of the players from Strasbourg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:0.
22' The referee points to the corner flag and Strasbourg will take a corner.
22' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg win a corner kick.
19' The foul by Christopher Wooh (Rennes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Eric Wattellier.
19' A rebound falls to Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.

19' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot inside the left post, but Steve Mandanda makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
18' A clumsy foul by Amine Gouiri (Rennes) and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle.
17' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
15' Strasbourg keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
13' Eric Wattellier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg).
12' The game is interrupted. Caleb Wiley (Strasbourg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

9' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Steve Mandanda was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
9' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
8' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) was too forceful with his tackle and Eric Wattellier interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
7' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
4' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
2' Rennes are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Rennes will kick-off.
Eric Wattellier will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
